stem.text: Limonene is an oil formed in the peel of citrus fruits.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of limonene, labelled limonene: a cyclohexene ring with a CH3 on one alkene carbon of the ring, and a C(CH3)=CH2 group on the ring carbon opposite it.

stem.text: Which product is formed when an excess of bromine, $\text{Br}_2\text{(l)}$, reacts with limonene at room temperature in the dark?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with a CH3 on the ring C=C, a C(CH3)=CH2 group on one ring carbon and a Br on the adjacent ring carbon.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: saturated ring with a C(CH3)=CH2 group on one carbon; one ring carbon bears CH3 and Br, and the adjacent ring carbon bears a Br.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with a CH3 on the ring C=C, and a CH3–C(Br)–CH2Br group on one ring carbon.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: saturated ring with a CH3–C(Br)–CH2Br group on one ring carbon; one ring carbon bears CH3 and Br, and the adjacent ring carbon bears a Br.
